name: lynx_net_diag
description: Entity: Lynx. Network diagnostic and security audit toolkit: net-ifaces, lan-sweep, wifi-recon, port-scan, vuln-check, ssl-audit, dns-audit, traceroute, packet-sample. Supports background forked execution (fork: true) with findings streamed into senses. Rules (LNX-25, enforced): port-scan and vuln-check only against yourself and the Noobia LAN (192.168.100.0/24); traceroute, dns-audit and ssl-audit may reach public addresses; packet-sample is refused unless a person allowed it, because it records other people's traffic. Every request is logged.

target.description: Target IP or hostname (for port-scan, vuln-check, or traceroute)

fork.description: If true, forks execution into background immediately; findings stream into senses log
